title: Requalify the AirfRANS CFD reference
question: Does the pinned OpenFOAM workflow reproduce the three AirfRANS reference solutions under the approved reference-mesh exception?
hypothesis: The reference-equivalent meshes and full iteration schedules will permit the original force and surface-pressure criteria to be tested.
decision_rule: Require all three reference runs to pass the approved mesh decision, force convergence, integrated CL and CD, and surface pressure checks. Score matched shapes only after qualification.
budget: 50 allocated CPU-core-hours and zero GPU-hours, on Eureka2 parallel scratch. 48 core-hours reserved for the three 16-core jobs including in-allocation verification.
